_comment: scripts/lint/orphan_header_check.py: engine/godot-src headers included by nothing outside tests/ and their own unit that are NOT staged policy code. Each entry names why it has no include consumer. The 2026-08-25 census debt was burned down on 2026-08-27 (threedi_compare moved to tests/threedi/, terrain/types.h deleted, serializing_sink.h STAGED with its owner named); never grow this list without a reason that names the consumer.

allow.engine/base/gameprofile/graphics_log.h: The game's graphics log (ghw.txt) reader the editor's Play findings read (engine/editor/session/play_log.cpp, play_controller.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/base/io/base64.h: The base64 encoder the editor's texture thumbnails put a PNG on the wire with (engine/editor/preview/texture_thumbnails.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/base/io/json.h: The strict JSON reader and writer of the editor's project files (apps/project/cli_verbs.cpp, engine/editor/documents/document_types.h). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/base/io/uuid.h: The version 4 UUID a new editor project takes as its id (engine/editor/project/project_document.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/base/vfs/file_stamps.h: The files a build read by stamp, which the editor's viewports follow (engine/editor/preview/viewport_follow.h, model_preview_rig.h). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/cbin/binary_config_text.h: The CBIN form and its ConfigFile text form, each into the other, that the editor's credits document holds a CBIN file by (engine/editor/documents/credits_type.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/def/def_hudpos_text.h: hudpos.def's lines as the game's parser is handed them, which the editor's HUD layout and HUD viewport place their edits by (engine/editor/preview/hud_layout_edit.cpp, engine/editor/preview/hud_viewport.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/def/reserved_items.h: The items.def ids the engine fixes, which the editor's catalogs keep (engine/editor/documents/catalog_validation.cpp, def_catalog_document.h). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/filelog/file_access_log.h: The original game's /FRISK file log, which the editor's Play reads once the game exits (engine/editor/run/launch_plan.cpp, engine/editor/session/play_controller.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/fnt/fnt_stroke_font.h: The stroke font assets/opennova.fnt and fixtures/fnt/synth_{1,3}page.fnt are minted from (tests/fixtures/minimal_fnt_gen.cpp, a test), which the editor's blank font writes (engine/editor/blank/blank_font.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/lwf/wav_source.h: The wave loader's acceptance walk and a source wave read and converted, which the editor's wave import, file card and sound previews use (engine/editor/import/wave_source.cpp, engine/editor/session/file_card.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/mnu/mnu_schema.h: The .mnu format's property rules the editor's menu table reads (engine/editor/documents/mnu_table.cpp, mnu_document.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/trn/charmap_legend.h: The char map legend the editor's terrain import and ground overlay paint with (engine/editor/import/terrain_import.cpp, engine/editor/preview/mission_ground_overlay.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/runtime/particle/effect_closure.h: The particle effect closure the editor's effect previews draw (engine/editor/preview/effect_viewport.h, effect_catalog.h). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/runtime/renderer/shader_effect_in: The tags a shader file registers (the fixed-function compiles, an effect's EffectInfo), which the editor's shader document defines as its symbols (engine/editor/documents/text_types.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/runtime/terrain_query/foliage_mas: The terrain's foliage map the editor's ground facts read (engine/editor/preview/mission_ground_facts.h). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.godot/src/register_types.h: The GDExtension entry-point declaration: consumed by its own register_types.cpp plus the .gdextension config's entry_symbol resolution at load time - the linker/loader is the consumer, not an #include.
